description: Anonymized ego-relative road geometry regression cases. Coordinates and confidence are rounded. The loader applies logged scalar uncertainty only through the first boundary knot beyond 30 m; farther per-point uncertainty is unavailable and treated as untrusted. No absolute times, locations, identifiers, camera frames, or vehicle identity are retained. Published selected trajectories serve as unsafe input examples, not an exact replay of hidden native model inputs.

cases.name: gentle_right_offset
cases.description: Gentle right curve with ego displaced toward the inside lane line.

cases.name: right_shoulder_handoff
cases.description: Right curve with a shoulder outside the painted lane and an inward policy trajectory.

cases.name: right_inside_recovery
cases.description: Ego already overlaps the right painted line; recovery must not worsen penetration.

cases.name: tight_right_approach
cases.description: Increasing right curvature with a lane-relative heading error.

cases.name: tight_left_exit
cases.description: Decreasing left curvature and an existing lane-relative offset.
